user.title: Connect to your Valerion projector
user.description: Enable AWOL Link on the projector first: All Settings > Inputs > External Inputs > AWOL Link. The projector must be on or in standby for this step; if it does not answer in standby, switch it on.

data_description.host: The projector's IP address on your network. Give it a fixed address (DHCP reservation) in your router.
data_description.port: Leave at 4352 unless you changed it on the projector.
data_description.security_code: Only if you set a security code in the AWOL Link menu. Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.mac: Needed to switch the projector on from standby (Wake-on-LAN). Find it under All Settings > System > About > Status. Optional: it can be added later with the settings (gear) button of the projector's entry.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the projector at this address and port.
error.awol_link_off: The projector refused the connection, so AWOL Link is switched off. Switch it on under All Settings > Inputs > External Inputs > AWOL Link, then try again.
error.invalid_auth: The projector rejected the security code.
error.projector_asleep: The projector accepted the connection but did not answer. It may be in deep standby, or another app that uses AWOL Link may be connected. Switch the projector on, close that app, then try again.
error.invalid_host: This is not a valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address (expected 12 hexadecimal digits, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Projector settings
init.description: Changes apply right away; the projector's entities and history stay as they are.

data_description.mac: Used to switch the projector on from standby with Wake-on-LAN. Find it under All Settings > System > About > Status. Recommended for every model: switching on then also works when the projector has left the network in standby. Leave empty to remove it.

error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address (expected 12 hexadecimal digits, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

projector_asleep.message: The projector did not answer. It is in standby or another app that uses AWOL Link is connected to it.

command_rejected.message: The projector rejected {command} with {error}. ERR2 means an invalid value, ERR3 means the setting is locked for the current picture format.

power_on_timeout.message: The projector did not wake up in time: {error}

power_on_needs_mac.message: The projector is in standby and cannot be woken without its MAC address. Add it with the settings (gear) button in Settings > Devices & services > Valerion.

invalid_key.message: {key} is not a known key. Valid keys: {keys}.

projector_off.message: The projector is not on, so it cannot receive key presses. Switch it on first.

invalid_raw_command.message: {command} is not a valid AWOL Link command. Write it like %1POWR ? or %3RCNC 4: a percent sign, the class digit, the four-letter code, a space and the value.

setting_locked.message: The projector refused {command} because this setting is locked for the current signal (ERR3). For example, gamma presets work only in SDR and dynamic tone mapping only in HDR10. The setting now shows as unavailable while this signal format and picture mode are active.

color_temperature_rejected.message: The projector refused {command} (ERR2). Warm 1 and Warm 2 only work when the projector's menu language is English (US), a known firmware issue.

motion_mode_rejected.message: The projector refused {command} (ERR2): it does not offer this motion enhancement mode. For example, the VisionMaster Pro2 has no Film mode.

aspect_ratio_rejected.message: The projector refused {command} (ERR2). The aspect ratio can only be changed while an HDMI signal is playing.

lens_menu_unsupported.message: The projector refused {command} (ERR3): this model has no motorized lens shift, zoom or focus. The button is now hidden. If this was a mistake, enable and press Forget learned locks on the device page.

lens_menu_unavailable.message: The projector refused {command} (ERR3). This model may not have a motorized lens shift, zoom or focus, or the menu cannot be opened right now. You can disable this button on the device page if your projector does not support it.

value_not_settable.message: {value} is reported by the projector but cannot be set.

send_raw_command.name: Send raw command
send_raw_command.description: Sends one AWOL Link command line to the projector and returns its reply. For testing and for commands that have no entity yet. The projector may accept commands that are not in the official list; use them at your own risk.

config_entry.name: Projector
config_entry.description: The projector to send the command to. Can be left empty when only one projector is configured.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command line, for example %1POWR ? (query) or %3RCNC 4 (OK key). See the official AWOL Link command list.
